description: The information layer, as an artifact rather than a number someone typed. Every command exposed by the single clawock distribution appears exactly once: inside a layer, or in `excluded` with the reason it is not information collection. The README tables in both languages are checked against these counts by tests/test_information_layer_taxonomy.py; the taxonomy previously survived #429 moving every module it counted, because nothing tied the two together.
inclusion_rule: A module is in the information layer if it acquires data from outside the repository, or computes a deterministic measure over market, book or strategy history. Everything else is excluded and listed with its reason: publishing an artifact, recording or gating a decision, relaying one that was already made, carrying operator input, and the delivery, scheduling and watchdog machinery around a run. Being read by a scheduled run is not the test — the brief reads its own work queue too — and neither is running on a schedule: the regime evaluations are manual and are measurements all the same.

dashboard-build.reason: publishes the dashboard projection from data the layers already produced

decision-map.reason: joins decisions to signal histories the layers already collected and publishes the projection; it acquires nothing and decides nothing

dashboard-outputs.reason: publication ownership and semantic diffs for generated write sets

validate-sidecar.reason: behavioral validation of a publication artifact

evidence.reason: renders the public evidence page from artifacts; it collects nothing

run-card.reason: records that a backtest ran and against what — provenance, not a measurement

claim-provenance.reason: gate: a quoted backtest number must still be in the card it cites

signal-panel.reason: measures registered signal histories that other layers already collected, and never feeds a decision — evaluation, not collection

scorecard-provenance.reason: names the ledger slice and code a published scorecard number came from — provenance, not a measurement

provenance.reason: gate: a published research figure needs two independent sources

mark-followed.reason: writes execution ground truth into the decision ledger

record.reason: appends a conversation verdict to the decision-mind ledger — it records a decision that was already made, and collects nothing

risk.reason: durable governance ledger for breaches — a record of decisions, not an input to one

thesis.reason: registry the model writes and reads back; its content is authored, not fetched

entry-gate.reason: pre-investment gate applied to a candidate, after the information exists

plan-context.reason: relays what the 08:00 brief already decided to the crons that run after it

research.reason: the brief does read it, but as a work queue — reviews due, overdue promises, ungated positions — not as a measurement of the market or the book

clawock-gold-update.reason: operator command that amends the gold DCA baseline; it carries human input into the book rather than measuring it

clawock-weekly-review.reason: assembles a weekly review artifact out of records the layers already produced

clawock-workflow-outcomes.reason: durable per-slot outcome state for the harness; operational, not market or book

clawock-cron-heartbeat.reason: publishes the intraday heartbeat ledger — liveness, not evidence

clawock-brief-fallback.reason: off-host delivery path for the brief when the runtime cannot produce it

clawock-intraday-delta.reason: pre-model trigger state: it decides whether a run happens, and the scheduler is its only reader

clawock-brief-watchdog.reason: delivery watchdog for the 08:00 brief: it checks that a run produced and sent something

clawock-report-watchdog.reason: delivery watchdog for the session reports, on the same footing

clawock-intraday-watchdog.reason: delivery watchdog for the intraday slots, on the same footing

registries.clawock: clawock.cli.PACKAGED_UTILITIES — subcommands dispatched by the public CLI.
registries.standalone: Additional console commands in the root pyproject.toml [project.scripts]; this is a second command surface of the same clawock distribution, not a second owner or package.
registries.not_classified: The package-owned lifecycle phase registry in clawock.harness.runner is excluded because phases consume and assemble the information layers; counting them would count the reader as one of the things read.
